messages.author: 854a0709976c2a48
messages.subject: Re: 7 Testing (Validation) of configurations
parts:
> testing_fromlog("irace.Rdata")
# Testing of elite configurations: 1  
# Testing iteration configurations: FALSE  
# 2022-07-04 17:29:56 CEST: No test instances, skip testing
[1] FALSE

When I look into your file with:

> load("irace.Rdata")
> iraceResults$scenario$testInstancesFile
[1] ""

So there are no test instances. I'm not sure how you ended up with no testInstancesFile. Perhaps you changed the scenario AFTER running irace? testing.main does not re-read the scenario file.

The function testing_fromlog() in irace 3.5 is much more flexible than testing.main() and you can do:

> testing_fromlog("irace.Rdata", testInstances="C:/pipeless_plant_scheduler/OptiProd_optimizer/Pipeless")

to add test instances to an existing scenario for testing purposes: https://mlopez-ibanez.github.io/irace/reference/testing_fromlog.html

Cheers,

Manuel.
